description: Generates a structured JSON representation from a SysML XMI model using an EGL template. Produces a custom JSON layout with namespaces, packages, partDefinitions, attributeDefinitions, and their nested features. This is a direct SysML-to-JSON extraction without intermediate model transformation.

model.description: Source model filename in the repository (e.g., VehicleDefinitions.xmi)

metamodel.description: Source metamodel name (e.g., SysML). Helps select the right endpoint.

output.description: Output filename. If omitted, auto-generated based on the input.
A custom structured JSON representation of the SysML model.
